member.name: T:ExtractInvoiceData.ShapeInvoice
member.summary: Reshapes an IXP extraction (project InvoicesIXP: Invoice Header, Vendor Information, Buyer Information, Line Items, Invoice Totals) into the exercise's invoice object — the same shape the generator writes, so the deterministic compare and the agent read one format. Extraction mistakes pass through untouched: that is the point of extracting at all.

member.name: M:ExtractInvoiceData.ShapeInvoice.Keys(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Every name a field can be found under: the display name, the id, and the id's last segment (after '.', '>' or '/').

member.name: M:ExtractInvoiceData.ShapeInvoice.ParseNumber(System.String)
member.summary: "4,923.00 USD" → 4923.00; "19%" → 19; "1.234,50 EUR" → 1234.50. Null when nothing numeric is there.

member.name: M:ExtractInvoiceData.ShapeInvoice.IsoDate(System.String)
member.summary: IXP returns ISO timestamps ("2026-06-04T00:00:00Z") or printed dates; keep yyyy-MM-dd where it can be read.
